sources.title: neutts-nano: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview neutts-nano is an English-language text-to-speech model built by neuphonic for on-device synthesis with instant voice cloning. The model combines a compact language model backbone (116.8M active parameters, 228.7M total) with NeuCodec, an open-source neural audio codec that delivers quality at low bitrates using a single codebook. It runs on CPU with real-time or better-than-real-time ...
